fact: Cabinet Decision No. 40 of 2025, issued 29 January 2025, set up the National Programme for AI and Digital Transformation with legal personality under the Government Communication Centre, with tasks on AI use and policy but none on AI harms.
title: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 40 لسنة 2025 م بشأن اعتماد البرنامج الوطني للذكاء الاصطناعي والتحول الرقمي
